15	#pragma once
16	
17	#include <memory>
18	#include <arrow/acero/api.h>
19	#include <arrow/chunked_array.h>
20	#include <zvec/db/status.h>
21	#include "db/index/column/inverted_column/inverted_search_result.h"
22	#include "db/index/common/index_filter.h"
23	#include "db/index/segment/segment.h"
24	#include "db/sqlengine/analyzer/query_info.h"
25	#include "db/sqlengine/analyzer/query_node.h"
26	
27	namespace zvec::sqlengine {
28	
29	class DocFilter : public IndexFilter {
30	 public:
31	  using Ptr = std::shared_ptr<DocFilter>;
32	
33	  DocFilter(Segment::Ptr segment, QueryInfo::Ptr query_info,
34	            std::unique_ptr<arrow::acero::Declaration> forward_plan,
35	            std::unique_ptr<arrow::compute::Expression> forward_filter)
36	      : segment_(std::move(segment)),
37	        query_info_(std::move(query_info)),
38	        delete_filter_(segment_->get_filter()),
39	        invert_cond_(query_info_->invert_cond()),
40	        forward_plan_(std::move(forward_plan)),
41	        forward_filter_expr_(std::move(forward_filter)) {}
42	
43	  Status compute_filter();
44	
45	  bool is_filtered(uint64_t id) const override;
46	
47	  //! When invert cardinality <= \p ratio * doc_count, extract the ids and
48	  //! clear invert_filter_ so the caller drives evaluation by ids instead of
49	  //! bitmap-checking. Ratio is per-caller (vector vs FTS use different
50	  //! GlobalConfig knobs) because per-candidate cost differs.
51	  std::optional<std::vector<uint64_t>> get_bf_by_keys_and_update(float ratio);
52	
53	  bool empty() const;
54	
55	 private:
56	  std::optional<bool> get_forward_bit(uint64_t id) const;
57	  std::optional<bool> is_matched_by_forward_filter(uint64_t id) const;
58	
59	 private:
60	  Segment::Ptr segment_;
61	  QueryInfo::Ptr query_info_;
62	  IndexFilter::Ptr delete_filter_;
63	  QueryNode::Ptr invert_cond_;
64	  // either forward_plan_ or forward_expr_ is set
65	  std::unique_ptr<arrow::acero::Declaration> forward_plan_;
66	  std::unique_ptr<arrow::compute::Expression> forward_filter_expr_;
67	
68	  InvertedSearchResult::Ptr invert_result_;
69	  IndexFilter::Ptr invert_filter_{nullptr};
70	
71	  std::shared_ptr<arrow::ChunkedArray> forward_bitmap_;
72	};
73	
74	}  // namespace zvec::sqlengine
